descriptions.d27h_blimp_camera_ctor_800a8348: Blimp camera constructor: runs the base constructor 0x8015a0d4, sets the table pointer at +72, clears the retained references +120..+180, resolves Land.MaxHeight, the Camera.Blimp settings and Land.Center into them, then writes AIStrike.SeekTarget as 0 and returns self.
